metaDescription: GitLab is an open-core DevSecOps platform with Git repos, CI/CD pipelines, security scanning and project management. See its features, Free, Premium and Ultimate pricing, strengths and limitations.
overview: GitLab is an open-core DevSecOps platform that combines source code management, CI/CD pipelines, container registry, security scanning, issue tracking and project planning in a single application. It can be self-hosted or used as a managed cloud service on GitLab.com.

GitLab offers three tiers: Free, Premium at $29 per user per month, and Ultimate with custom pricing. AI-powered features are available through GitLab Duo, and the platform includes 50,000 compute minutes per month on the Free plan for running CI/CD pipelines.

features.title: Source code management
features.text: Git repositories with merge requests, code review, branching strategies and protected branches.

features.title: CI/CD pipelines
features.text: Built-in continuous integration and delivery with auto-scaling runners and 50,000 free compute minutes per month.

features.title: Security scanning
features.text: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning and secret detection on Ultimate.

features.title: Issue tracking and planning
features.text: Issues, boards, milestones, epics and roadmaps for project management within the same platform.

features.title: Container registry
features.text: Built-in container registry for storing and managing Docker images alongside your code.

features.title: GitLab Duo AI
features.text: AI-powered code suggestions, chat, vulnerability explanation and merge request summaries.

strengths: Single platform for the entire DevSecOps lifecycle, from planning to monitoring.
Can be self-hosted for full control over data and infrastructure.
Built-in CI/CD with generous free compute minutes.
Open-core model; the core platform is open source.
Comprehensive security scanning on the Ultimate tier.
limitations: Premium at $29/user/mo is significantly more expensive than GitHub's paid plans.
The free plan limits private namespaces to five users.
Ultimate pricing is not published; requires contacting sales.
The interface can feel complex for teams new to DevOps tooling.
Performance on large repositories can be slower than GitHub.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Premium is priced per user per month. Ultimate requires contacting sales. AI features (GitLab Duo) are available as add-ons.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 5 users per private namespace · 5 GB storage · 50,000 compute minutes/mo

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: Up to 100,000 users · merge request approvals · push rules · code quality reports

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.note: Annual billing · advanced security scanning · compliance management · vulnerability management
